title: Amazon Cognito User Pools
description: Learn how to set up Cognito User Pools for user sign-up, sign-in, and management in your applications.

data.text: **Amazon Cognito User Pools** is a fully managed user directory that scales to millions of users. It handles user registration, authentication, and account recovery so you do not have to build your own identity system.

A User Pool is a user directory specific to your application. When a user signs up, Cognito stores their profile (email, phone, custom attributes) and provides tokens your app can use to verify the user's identity.

data.title: Key Features
items: **Sign-up and sign-in** — users can create accounts and log in
**Multi-factor authentication (MFA)** — extra security with SMS or TOTP
**Password policies** — enforce complexity and rotation rules
**Custom attributes** — store app-specific data like user roles
**User migration** — import users from another identity provider
**Lambda triggers** — run custom code at points in the auth flow

data.title: Beginner Tip
data.text: Cognito User Pools are free for up to 50,000 monthly active users. This makes it a great choice for startups and small projects.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: User Pools are managed user directories for your apps
MFA and password policies improve account security
Custom attributes let you store app-specific user data
Lambda triggers enable custom logic in the auth flow
